name: JustLegal OS Legal & Whistleblower Navigator

tagline: Offline legal document formatting and honest fact verification under 28 U.S.C. § 530C(b)(1)(L) and the False Claims Act.
description: An autonomous legal navigator for pro se litigants, citizen observers, and whistleblowers. Operates local-first with zero telemetry, replaces vanity scores with honest 4-state verification receipts (VERIFIED, USER_STATED, MISSING, LOOKUP_FAILED), enforces the insider vs outsider routing fork, and applies fail-closed packet linter audits before export.
